title: Active State Keeps Emphasized Color
description: Active interactive elements (navbar toggles, etc.) should keep emphasized text color from hover when active/on.
summary: Active/on interactive states now mirror hover: normal-border gray fill + emphasized text. Added interactiveOnClass and interactiveTabActiveClass; updated toggleVariants, TabsTrigger active styling, app nav ButtonGroupItem, side panel tab active class, and navbar/footer/toolbar CSS rules for data-state=on. Removed primary active-base/foreground from toggles and toolbar on-state.
